senses.gloss:
mfn. (-रः-री or रा-रं)
Who or what takes or seizes, carries or conveys, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 ŚIVA.
2 AGNI.
3 An ass.
4 (In arithmetic,) A divisor; also the denominator of a fraction.
E.
हृ to take, aff. अप् or टच्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Who or what takes, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 A porter, a carrier.
2 Taking, conveying.
3 A string or garland of pearls, &c.
4 War, battle.
5 (In prosody,) A long syllable.
6 (In arithmetic,) A divisor, also the denominator of a fraction.
E.
हृ to seize, (the mind, &c.) and घञ् aff., or causal form, with अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A rogue, a cheat.
2 A person of reflection.
3 A taker, a conveyer, a seizer.
4 (In arithmetic,) A divisor; also division.
5 ŚIVA.
E.
हृ to take, वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A thief.
2 A cheat, a rogue.
3 Prose.
4 Science.
5 A gambler.
6 A tree, (Trophis aspera.)
7 A plunderer, a ravisher, one who carries off any thing.
8 (In arithmetic,) A divisor.
E.
हृ to take, aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-णिः)
The moon.
E.
हर ŚIVA, चूडा the crest, and मणि a gem.

n. (-णं)
Taking, (either in a good or bad sense,) accepting, receiving, seizing, carrying off or away.
2 A special gift, as a nuptial present, alms to a student at his initiation, &c.
3 The arm.
4 Semen virile.
5 Gold.
6 A Kowri.
7 Boiling water.
8 (In arithmetic,) Dividing, division.
m. (-णः)
The hand.
E.
हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be taken, seized, accepted, &c.
E.
हृ to take, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत)
Taking, seizing.
E.
हृ to take, शतृ aff.

n. (-जं)
Quicksilver.
E.
हर ŚIVA, and वीज semen.

f. (-रा)
The Ganges.
E.
हर ŚIVA, and शेखरा crest.

f. (-रा)
A grape; also हारहूरा.

n. (-रं)
Wine, vinous liquor.
f. (-रा)
A grape.

m. (-द्रिः)
Mount Kailāsa, the favourite resort of ŚIVA.
E.
हर ŚIVA, and अद्रि mountain.

1 Green.
2 Tawny.
3 Yellow.

1 VIṢṆU, or as considered to be the same deity, KṚṢṆA.
2 YAMA.
3 Air, wind.
4 INDRA.
5 The moon.
6 The sun.
7 A lion.
8 A ray of light.
9 A horse.
10 A parrot.
11 An ape.
12 A snake.
13 A frog.
14 ŚIVA.
15 One of the nine Varṣas into which the known continent is divided.
16 BRAHMĀ.
17 Fire.
18 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
19 A goose.
20 A peacock.
21 Green, (the colour.)
22 Tawny, the colour.
23 A golden colour, or yellow.
E.
हृ to take, to seize, (the world or men's hearts, &c.,) Uṇādi aff. इ.

mfn. (-रिः-रिः or -री-रि)
Handsome, charming.
f. (-रिः)
1 Defeat, discomfiture, either in war or gambling, &c.
2 A traveller's progeny or family.
f. (-री)
A pearl.
E.
हृ to take or steal, aff. इञ्, optionally in the fem. form ङीष् added.

m. (-कः)
1 A horse of a yellowish blue tint.
2 A thief.
3 A gambler.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-यः)
Bengal.
E.
हरि VIṢṆU, केलि sport, and छ aff.

m. (-शः)
ŚIVA.
E.
हरि VIṢṆU, क BRAHMĀ, and ईश lord.

n. (-हं)
A city and district, also Sambhalpur.
E.
हरि VIṢṆU, and गृह abode.

mn. (-नः-नं)
1 A yellow and fragrant sort of Sandal wood.
2 One of the trees of paradise.
n. (-नं)
1 Saffron.
2 Moon-light.
3 The farina of the lotus.
4 The person of a lover or mistress.
E.
हरि VIṢṆU, or yellow, and चन्दन Sandal.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Yellowish white.
m. (-णः)
1 A deer.
2 Yellowish white, (the colour.)
3 White.
4 VIṢṆU.
5 ŚIVA.
6 The sun.
7 A goose.
8 A minor division of the world.
f. (-णी)
1 A doe.
2 A golden image.
3 A woman, one of the four kinds, the same as the Citriṇī, or female of the man termed Mṛga.
4 A form of metre, a variety of the class termed Atyaṣṭi or verse of four lines of 17 syllables each.
5 Green: see हरित.
6 Yellow jasmine.
E.
हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इनच्.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Relating to deer, (deer-flesh, skin, &c.)
E.
हरिण, and अण् aff.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The moon.
E.
हरिण a deer, कलङ्क a spot.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Deer-eyed.
E.
हरिण, and नयन the eye; also हरिण, लोचन, हरिणाक्षि, &c.

m. (-कः)
A chorister of INDRA'S heaven.
E.
हरिण a deer, and नर्त्तक a dancer.

f. (-ता)
A stanza having eleven syllables in every first and third Pāda, and twelve in every second and fourth.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fearful, timid.
E.
हरिण a deer, and हृदय heart; deer-hearted.

f. (-क्षी)
1 A perfume, commonly Hāttavilāsinī.
2 A woman with handsome eyes.
E.
हरिण a deer, and अक्षि the eye, fem. aff. ङीष.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The moon.
E.
हरिण a deer, and अङ्क mark or symbol.

mfn. (-रित्)
Green, of a green colour.
m. (-त्)
1 Green, (the colour.)
2 A swift horse or a horse of the sun.
3 Kidneybean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
4 A lion.
5 The sun.
6 VIṢṆU.
mn. (-रित्)
Grass.
f. (-रित्).
1 A quarter or region, a point of the compass.
2 Turmeric.
E.
हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इति.

mfn. (-तः-ता or रिणी-तं)
1 Green, of a green colour. []
2 Grassy, verdant.
m. (-तः)
1 Green, (the colour.)
2 A lion.
f. (-ता)
1 Bent grass.
2 Turmeric.
3 A brown or tawny grape.
E.
हृ to take, इतन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Lost, relinquished, made away with.
m. (-तः)
1 The green or wood pigeon.
2 Green, the colour.
E.
हृ to take, causal v., क्त aff., or हरित् green, अण् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 The green or wood pigeon, (Columba hariala, BUC.)
2 A Muni, and legislator.
3 Roguery, cheating, fraud.
E.
हार a necklace, or हारि defeat, and इत gone, got; or हरित green, अण् aff., and the vowel made long.

n. (-कः)
A potherb.
E.
हरित green, and कन् added.

n. (-कं)
A potherb.
E.
हरित the same, ठन् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Green-leaved.
E.
हरित, and छद a leaf.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Becoming green.
E.
हरित used as a verb, शतृ aff.

n. (-लं)
Yellow orpiment.
f. (-ली)
1 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.)
2 A streak or line in the sky, (the milky way?)
3 A sort of creeper.
E.
हरित green, अल to possess or adorn, aff. अण्, fem. aff. ङीष्.

m. (-कः)
The green pigeon.
n. (-कं)
Theatrical decoration, painting the person, &c.
E.
हरिताल orpiment, कन् aff.

f. (-का)
1 A sort of grass, (Panicum dactylon, Rox.)
2 The fourth lunar day of the month Bhadra.
E.
कन् added to हरिताल, fem. form.

n. (-श्म)
1 Blue vitriol.
2 A turquoise.
3 An emerald.
E.
हरित green, अश्मन् a stone.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made verdant or green, coloured green, &c.
E.
हरित, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.

n. (-र्णं)
A radish.
E.
हरित् green, and पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-श्वः)
The sun.
E.
हरित् green, and अश्व a horse.

m. (-वः)
The asterism Srāvaṇa.
E.
हरि VIṢṆU, and देव presiding deity.

m. (-वः)
A powder of the blossoms of the Mesua ferrea.

f. (-द्रा)
Turmeric, (either the plant or the powdered root.)
E.
हरित् green, द्रु to flow or ooze, aff. ड, or हरि VIṢṆU, &c., दृ to be regarded, aff. क.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं)
1 Stained, dyed, or coloured with turmeric.
2 Yellow.
m. (-द्रः)
1 The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Cadamba.)
2 Yellow, (the colour.)
E.
हरिद्रा turmeric, and अण् or अञ् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Smeared or stained with turmeric.
E.
हरिद्रा, and अक्त anointed.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A yellow bird.
E.
हरिद्रा turmeric, and अङ्ग body.

Of a yellow colour.

1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)

E.
हरिद्रा turmeric, आभ resembling.

Fickle, capricious, unsteady, in affection or attachment.

m. (-द्रुः)
1 A tree.
2 A plant, (Curcuma zanthorrhizon.)
E.

m. (-मा)
A kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
E.

m. (-त्रः)
An owl.
n. (-त्रं)
The white lotus.
E.
हरि VIṢṆU, &c., and नेत्र an eye.

m. (-णिः)
An emerald.
E.
हरित् green, and मणि a gem.

n. (-र्णं)
A radish.
E.
हरि green, and पर्ण a leaf; also हरित्पर्ण.

1 LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU.

हरि tawny, बालुका sand.

A sort of perfume, commonly Elavāluka.

A snake.
E.

Time.
E.

m. (-न्थः)
1 A tree, (Premna longifolia.)
2 Chick pea.
E.

Chick pea, (Cicer arietinum.)

m. (-जः)
1 Chick pea.
2 A sort of kidney-bean.

A horse of a yellow colour.

1 A crab.
2 An owl.

INDRA.
E.

m. (-नः)
GARUḌA.

Yellow orpiment.

हरि VIṢṆU, and वीज semen.

A division of the continent: see हरिवर्ष.

ŚIVA.
E.

E.
हरि VIṢṆU, and चन्द्र the moon.

n. (-रं)
The city of HARIŚCANDRA: see the last.
E.
हरिश्चन्द्र a name, and पुर city.

m. (-णः)
The tenth of the twelve universal emperors enumerated by the Jainas.
E.
हरि VIṢṆU, &c., and सेना a host.

m. (-तः)
One of the emperors of the Jainas; also named HARIṢEṆA.
E.
हरि VIṢṆU, and सुत the son.

m. (-यः)
1 INDRA.
2 The sun.
3 SKANDA.
4 GAṆEŚA.
E.
हरि green, and हय a horse.

m. (-कः)
1 GARUḌA.
2 DAKṢA.
E.

Yellow or Chebulic myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula); seven varieties of this are distinguished.

f. (-णुः)

m. (-णुः)
1 Laṅkā.
2 A creeper, marking the boundary of a village.
E.
हृ to take, एणु Uṇādi aff.

To be seized, taken, accepted, &c.
E.

n. (-र्म्म)

E.
हृ to take, मनिन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thrown, cast, sent.

m. (-टः)
1 The sun.

m. (-र्य्यः)
Beleric myrobalan.
E.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A lion.

E.
हरि tawny or green, and अक्षि the eye, षच् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 A horse.
2 A steed fit for an Aśvamedha.
E.
हृ to take, अतच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-श्वः)
INDRA.

Happy, delighted.

Joy, pleasure, delight, happiness.
E.

Causing delight, gratifying, delighting.
E.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Joyful, cheerful, happy.
E.

Gold.

Overjoyed.

Joyful.

Happy, delighted, gladdened, made glad or happy.

n. (-लः)

E.

Great happiness.

हर्ष, and उदय rising.

f. (-की)

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)

E.
